tittel: The Title of the Dissertation: How African American Males Overcame Challenges To Persist at a Predominantly White Institution in the South: A Phenomenological Study
sammendrag: The purpose of this transcendental phenomenological study was to understand the lived experiences of African American males who graduate from a predominantly White institution (PWI) in the South. The theory guiding the study is Vincent Tinto’s dropout theory. The dropout theory suggests students will persist in graduation if they are academically and socially integrated in the college environment. The central research question in the study was: What were the lived experiences of African American males who persisted to graduation from a predominantly White institution in the South? Purposeful snowball sampling was utilized to obtain 10 African American male participants who graduated from a PWI in the South. The setting was Ledone University, a predominantly White institution in the southern region of the United States. In-depth interviews, focus groups, and reflective letters were utilized to collect the data. The data analysis approach utilized was Moustakas’s transcendental-phenomenological reduction, imaginative variation, and epoche` methodology to understand the meaning, nature, and essence of the phenomena lived by the participants. The research revealed four themes: community, mentorship, academic integration, and social integration. The 10 African American males overcame challenges to graduate from a predominantly White institution by experiencing the importance of finding their community, mentorship, academic, and social integration. The recommendation for future research is the impact of mentoring on the academic success of African American males in higher education. A qualitative research design is appropriate to provide rich and textured narratives.

tittel: DOES VOCATIONAL EDUCATION PAY OFF? WAGE AND UNEMPLOYMENT EFFECTS OF VOCATIONAL HIGH SCHOOL IN INDONESIA
kilde: International Journal of Business and Society
sammendrag: This study examines the labor market performance of Vocational High School (VHS) graduates in Indonesia, with a focus on wage attainment and the probability of unemployment. Utilizing data from the Indonesian National Labor Force Survey (SAKERNAS) for the years 2021 and 2022, with approximately 1.25 million individual observations, this study employs a robust treatment effects framework using Inverse Probability Weighted Regression Adjustment (IPWRA). To capture distributional heterogeneity in wage outcomes, IPWRA estimates are complemented by quantile regressions at the 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles, attempting to analyze vocational wage returns across wage distribution. The findings indicate that vocational high school (VHS) education yields an average wage premium of 27.8% across the wage distribution, with the strongest effect observed among individuals in the lower quantiles of earnings. Furthermore, logit estimation results demonstrate that VHS graduates exhibit an 18.5% lower probability of unemployment compared to general high school (GHS) graduates, suggesting more favorable labor market outcomes associated with vocational education. These findings indicate that vocational high school education in Indonesia increases income and improves employment opportunities, particularly for workers in the lowest wage percentile. Policy implications highlight the importance of strengthening curriculum-industry alignment and transition mechanisms from high school to the workforce.

tittel: Can Early Exposure to the Teaching Profession Increase Teacher Supply and Diversity? New Evidence on the Teacher Pipeline
sammendrag: We examine whether early exposure to the teaching career has the potential to expand the size and diversity of new teacher supply.Exploiting the staggered expansion of high school education courses across Texas, we find little evidence that these courses increased new teacher supply or diversity despite course takers being substantially more diverse than the teacher workforce.High school education course takers who become teachers are similarly effective and more likely to be retained than their peers.Most course takers drop out of the teacher pipeline prior to college enrollment where racial gaps in 4-year college going serve as major barriers.Our findings suggest that early exposure without support to increase college going is unlikely to increase teacher supply or diversity.

tittel: Timing matters? An exploratory study of immersive virtual reality integration in middle school career and technical education
sammendrag: Career exploration in middle school is critical, yet Career and Technical Education (CTE) continues to face persistent challenges.While immersive virtual reality (IVR) has demonstrated value for engagement and skill learning, little research has examined its pedagogical integration in CTE, particularly the timing of its use.This quasi-experimental study (N = 42) compared three instructional conditions: IVR as introduction, IVR as review, and traditional CTE instruction (control).Results from baseline-endline surveys and weekly reflections over six weeks suggested that students in the control group experienced declines across all attitudinal measures, whereas IVR conditions helped sustain engagement and career awareness.Qualitative findings further indicated that the timing of IVR use may influence how students engage with and interpret CTE learning.Overall, this exploratory study provides preliminary evidence that IVR can serve as a pedagogical complement to CTE instruction, while the timing of its use, as another pedagogical design factor, warrants further investigation.

tittel: Increasing Teacher Efficacy to Improve Emergent Bilingual Student Achievement
sammendrag: This qualitative action research study explored how professional development impacted teachers’ perceptions of their ability to minimize achievement gaps between linguistically and culturally diverse students and typical White, English-speaking students within a junior high school setting in Texas. Despite increasing numbers of linguistically and culturally diverse students across the state, achievement gaps continue to persist, creating a high leverage need for increased professional development for teachers in both language literacy instruction and culturally relevant and responsive pedagogies. Data was collected through questionnaires and semi-structured interviews with campus teachers that were analyzed using thematic analysis. Findings revealed that while teacher participants valued the pedagogies within the study and believed they positively impacted student achievement, a lack of time, resources, and technology served as both real and perceived barriers to implementation of the pedagogies and their associated instructional practices. A major theme identified within the study was that participants possessed a partial understanding of the pedagogies and associated instructional strategies, but they lacked a clear and coherent framework that supported their ability to intentionally plan and embed associated strategies into their practice. Findings communicated that professional development increased teacher efficacy and provided a foundational knowledge and structure that allowed participants to successfully embed instructional practices within their work to support student outcomes and eliminate, or minimize the impact of, identified barriers to implementation. These results may inform campus and district educational leaders that are seeking to improve learning outcomes for linguistically and culturally diverse students through professional development that supports teaching professionals and encourages and supports changes in their professional practice.

tittel: Caught Between Two Worlds: A Study of Adolescent Development and College Readiness in Early College High Schools
sammendrag: Early College High Schools (ECHSs) provide students with opportunities to earn college credit while completing high school, with the goal of improving college readiness and expanding access to higher education for historically underserved populations. Although research has demonstrated positive academic outcomes for ECHS students, less was known about how teachers perceive students’ developmental readiness for accelerated college-level coursework. This qualitative study examined teachers’ perceptions of student readiness and support systems within two high-performing Early College High Schools in Texas. Guided by Piaget’s theory of cognitive development, Erikson’s psychosocial theory, and Vygotsky’s sociocultural theory, the study explored how teachers interpreted students’ ability to manage academic rigor, navigate emotional demands, sustain engagement, and access institutional supports. Data was collected through an open-ended teacher survey and focus groups. Thematic analysis was used to identify patterns across teacher perceptions of cognitive self-efficacy, emotional well-being, social engagement, and support system effectiveness. Findings indicated that student readiness was developmental and uneven, with cognitive confidence strengthening through structured support and early success. However, emotional stress and social disconnection significantly influenced student persistence. Support systems, particularly advisory, mentoring, and tutoring, are identified as the most critical factors in sustaining success, although inconsistencies in implementation limited their effectiveness. The study provides implications for educators and policymakers by emphasizing the importance of developmentally responsive, consistently implemented support systems to balance academic rigor with student well-being.

tittel: Splintering or Solving Academic Gaps: A Narrative Review of the Impacts of United States School Choice Mechanisms on Academic Outcomes and Equity Implications
sammendrag: School choice is a significant and polarizing policy issue with implications for millions of U.S. students. While charter and voucher programs were first established over three decades ago, debates continue about their impacts on students and on traditional public schools. This narrative review synthesizes evidence across diverse policy types–including charter schools, means-tested and universal voucher programs, education savings accounts, tax-credit scholarships, magnet schools, and intradistrict transfers–asking: To what extent does educational competition improve educational outcomes? Drawing on peer-reviewed studies, national meta-analyses, and policy research, evidence is synthesized across varied study designs, student populations, and geographic settings. This synthesis finds that academic outcomes vary considerably depending on policy structure and local market context, while highlighting critical gaps between theoretical assumptions of competitive pressure and actual instructional mechanisms. A key analytical contribution of this review is evaluating how existing papers rely on fiscal pressure–the idea that the threat of losing students and funding motivates schools to improve–as the primary explanatory mechanism for the benefits of competition. This reliance is undertheorized, leaving important questions about how competition produces gains underexamined. This review distinguishes internal choice-school practices from competitive spillovers in traditional public schools while examining broader equity dimensions such as transportation barriers, special education access, and administrative burdens. Addressing these questions is essential for future scholarship and for designing competition policies that deliver equitable outcomes.

tittel: A data mining-based early warning system for identifying at-risk students in higher vocational education
kilde: International Journal of Information and Communication Technology
sammendrag: Identifying students at risk of academic failure in higher vocational education is essential for timely intervention.Traditional assessment methods often overlook complex behavioural, socio-economic, and institutional factors.This work introduces a data mining-based early warning system (EWS) designed to identify at-risk students through intelligent predictive modelling.The proposed framework combines light gradient CatBoost classifier (LG-CatBoost) for powerful nonlinear risk prediction with artificial protozoa optimiser (APO) for adaptive hyperparameter tuning, resulting in highly accurate identification of at-risk students at an early stage.According to the results, APO-LG-CatBoost model established greater performance when compared to the existing methods, achieving a RMSE of 0.0789 and MAE of 0.0065, indicating high predictive accuracy and stability in estimating student risk levels and it attained a higher accuracy (92%), precision (84%), Recall (86%), and an F1-score (90%), reflecting balanced and reliable at-risk student's identification.

tittel: Workplace-based learning as an unexplored challenge to inclusion in vocational education: dilemmatic spaces in school actors’ narratives in apprenticeship education
sammendrag: Vocational education and training (VET) is promoted as an inclusion measure, and many students in need of special educational support attend VET. Despite this, VET is seldom focused in research on inclusive education. In particular, workplace-based learning within VET has been largely unexplored. This study examines the dilemmatic spaces articulated in school actors’ narratives within upper secondary apprenticeship education, focusing on the support provided to students during workplace-based learning amidst tensions created by conflicting policies and practices in VET. The results reveal three interconnected dilemmatic spaces: (i) reduction – concerning the content of the education, (ii) the organisation of the education and (iii) pedagogical care work vs. qualification frameworks and governing documents – i.e. the pedagogical approach. One conclusion drawn is that the common practice of reduction leaves students with fewer opportunities to develop vocational knowing and achieve learning goals, which might impact their future. Simultaneously, organisational hindrances leave schools struggling to find viable alternatives that better address students’ needs. These findings show that, for many students, workplace-based learning presents a new challenge rather than providing a solution to previous experiences with challenges within the educational system.

tittel: Intersectoral vulnerabilities in secondary school dropouts: A systematic review
sammendrag: This study examines the socioeconomic, academic, and family factors associated with secondary school dropout, distinguishing between recorded withdrawal and completion, as well as between prediction and intervention indicators. To this end, 30 reports of primary studies (2021–2026) were collected through searches targeting publishers and DOIs, and the findings were classified according to population, design, outcome variable, and three interrelated domains. Although the review followed PRISMA 2020 and PRISMA-S guidelines, the absence of a complete database export, a selection process audit, and a formal risk-of-bias assessment precludes it from being considered a fully reproducible systematic review. Regarding the results, evidence from various regions links dropout to material deprivation, youth employment, low academic performance, grade retention, chronic absenteeism, school disengagement, parental education levels, and household instability. However, cohort studies nuance simplistic explanations; for instance, the relevance of skills and aspirations varies by stage; in one case, self-perceived health showed no independent association after adjustments, and in another, there were no significant correlations at the household level. Furthermore, better predictive performance does not equate to verified prevention. In conclusion, material, academic, and family conditions interact in a context-dependent manner, without supporting a universal causal hierarchy.

tittel: Analisis Implementasi Kebijakan Pendidikan Vokasi dalam Mendorong Pembangunan Ekonomi Berbasis SDM Unggul di Indonesia
kilde: Prosiding Seminar Nasional Lembaga Penelitian Dan Pendidikan (LPP) Mandala
sammendrag: This study is motivated by the suboptimal implementation of vocational education policies in supporting human capital-based economic development in Indonesia. The study aims to analyze policy implementation, identify key challenges, and examine stakeholder roles through a literature review. A qualitative approach is employed using systematic literature synthesis. The findings reveal an implementation paradox, where policies are strong in design but weak in execution. Skill mismatch is identified as a systemic issue caused by the lack of alignment between education, industry, and policy frameworks. Limited institutional capacity and weak substantive collaboration further hinder policy effectiveness. Although vocational education has significant potential to drive economic development, its realization remains limited. Therefore, an ecosystem-based approach that integrates stakeholders systematically and focuses on outcomes is required.

tittel: A Landscape of Machine Learning Models for Predicting Student Dropouts in Developing Countries: Systematic Literature Review
sammendrag: In Sub-Saharan countries the student dropout rate elevated to 19% of secondary school age, followed by Northern Africa and Western Asia (9%) and Southern Asia (7%) in 2019. In Tanzania, student dropouts in secondary schools increased from 3.8% in 2018 to 4.2% in 2019. The persisting dropout problem especially in secondary schools is attributed to a lack of proper identification of root causes and unavailability of formal methods that can be used to project the severity of the problem. This study applied PICO and PRISMA to conduct systematic literature reviews to analyze and synthesize and report key results. Digital databases such as ACM library, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google scholar yielded 21 exhaustive articles from January 2014 to October 2023 regarding the student dropout features identification using machine learning models. Results revealed that distance, absence, child pregnancy, early marriage, and family income are the most evident predictors for student dropout. Presented articles did not cover psychological features leading to student dropout in developing countries. Student dropouts have complex psychological and behavioral issues demand a comprehensive analysis and understanding by machine learning algorithms. Disassociating psychological factors in dropout prediction remains inappropriately answered to determine root causes of student dropouts. Moreover, this study intends to synthesize the prediction accuracy of ML models when influential features are applied to predict student dropout in developing countries. This study concluded by highlighting the most evident Machine learning algorithms that showed high prediction accuracy; Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Neural Networks, and K -Nearest Neighbors.

tittel: A subject teacher´s perceptions of providing support after the reformed upper secondary school law
sammendrag: Asiasanat: Oppimisen haasteet, Aineenopettajat, Uudistunut lukiolaki Tutkimusaiheenani on lukion aineenopettajien kokemukset tuen tarjoamisesta uudistuneen lukiolain jälkeen.Aihe herätti minussa kiinnostusta heti, sillä kyseessä on iso muutos ja lukiomaailma kiinnostaa minua.Koen aiheen olevan tärkeä tutkimuskohde juuri sen takia, että muutos on suuri aikaisempaan.Varsinkin pienissä lukioissa ei aiemmin välttämättä ollut erityisopettajaa tarjolla eikä tukitoimiin aina panostettu.Ensimmäinen tutkimuskysymykseni liittyy opettajien näkemyksiin oppilaiden tuen tarpeista.Kartoitan erilaisia oppimiseen liittyviä haasteita, jotka ilmenevät tutkimuskohteenani olevassa lukiossa.Toinen tutkimuskysymykseni liittyy opettajien ammatilliseen osaamiseen.Tämän tutkimuskysymyksen keskiössä on yhteistyö, ammatillinen kehittyminen, suunnittelu ja tuen tarjoamiseen tarvittavien taitojen kehittyminen.Tuen tarpeiden ja oppimisen haasteiden osalta teoriapohjassani käsitellään matemaattisia sekä kirjoittamiseen ja lukemiseen liittyviä haasteita.Myös oppilaiden uupumus ja hyvinvointi ovat keskiössä.Opettajien ammatillista osaamista tutkin MAP-malliin pohjautuen.Aineistoni on kerätty tietystä pienestä lukiosta, josta löytyi seitsemän aineenopettajaa haastateltavaksi.Haastattelut olivat puolistrukturoituja ja analyysimenetelmänä toimi fenomenologinen analyysi.Tutkimukseni tärkeimmät havainnot ovat ensimmäisen tutkimuskysymyksen osalta oppilaiden samanaikainen heterogeenisyys sekä osalla oppilaista oleva huomattava tuen tarve.Koulu-uupumusta oli havaittavissa ja niihin vaikuttavina seikkoina nähtiin olevan vähäinen lepo sekä erilaiset kuormittavat tekijät.Opettajien ammatillinen osaaminen näkyi MAP-malliin peilaten parhaiten yhteistyönä muiden opettajien kanssa.Myös oppilaiden kohtaamisen taito korostui

tittel: ความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างการบริหารจัดการความเสี่ยง กับอัตราการหลุดออกจากระบบการศึกษาของนักเรียนในจังหวัดชัยภูมิ
sammendrag: The objectives of this research were: (1) to examine the level of risk management in educational institutions in Chaiyaphum Province, (2) to investigate the dropout rate of students, and (3) to analyze the correlation between risk management and student dropout rates. The sample group consisted of 250 school administrators under the Office of Chaiyaphum Primary Educational Service Area, selected using stratified and simple random sampling. The research instrument was a four-part questionnaire with a content validity index (CVI) of 1.00 and a reliability coefficient of 0.98. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics, Pearson’s correlation coefficient, and content analysis. The findings revealed that: (1) the overall level of risk management in educational institutions in Chaiyaphum Province was high, with the highest mean score in the areas of risk identification and risk management; (2) the overall dropout rate was 66.45 percent, with the highest dropout occurring at the lower primary education level. The major risk factors included poverty, gaming or mobile phone addiction, and migration; and (3) risk management was moderately and negatively correlated with student dropout rates, with statistical significance at the .01 level (r = –0.308).

tittel: Perceived learning difficulties, special educational teacher’s support, and academic well-being among upper secondary education students – a person-oriented approach
sammendrag: Tammikuu 2024 Oppimisvaikeudet vaikuttavat laajasti yksilön elämään niin koulussa kuin myöhemmin työelämässäkin.Oppimisessa voi olla kuitenkin haasteita ilman todettuja oppimisvaikeuksia ja onkin tärkeää huomioida opiskelijoiden omat kokemukset oppimisen ja opiskelun vaikeuksista.On tärkeää huomioida myös opiskeluhyvinvointi, jonka määrittelen tässä koostuvan opiskeluinnon ja opiskelu-uupumuksen ulottuvuuksista, sekä niiden dynamiikka oppimisvaikeuksien kanssa.Huolta on herättänyt etenkin lukiolaisten lisääntynyt uupumus.Tämän tutkielman tavoitteena onkin tarkastella toisen asteen opiskelijoiden kokemia oppimisvaikeuksia ja kokemuksia erityisopettajalta saadun tuen riittävyydestä sekä niiden yhteyksiä opiskeluhyvinvointiin.Aineisto on kerätty sähköisellä kyselylomakkeella kevätlukukaudella 2023 ja vastaajat olivat 846 lukioiden (82 %) ja ammatillisten oppilaitosten (18 %) opiskelijaa eri puolilta Suomea.Aineiston analysoinnissa on käytetty muuttujien rakenteen tarkasteluun eksploratiivista ja konfirmatorista faktorianalyysiä.Opiskelijat jaoteltiin opiskeluhyvinvoinnin profiileihin latentilla profiilianalyysillä ja näiden profiilien eroja koetuissa oppimisvaikeuksissa ja kokemuksissa erityisopettajan tuen riittävyydestä tarkasteltiin varianssianalyysillä ja ristiintaulukoinneilla.Oppimiseen ja opiskeluun liittyviä vaikeuksia koettiin opiskelutaidoissa, itsenäisessä työskentelyssä sekä sosiaalisissa tilanteissa.Suurin osa opiskelijoista ei ollut kuitenkaan kokenut tarvetta erityisopettajan tuelle opiskeluun (76 %) eikä hyvinvointiin (77 %) liittyvissä asioissa.Aineistosta muodostui viisi opiskeluhyvinvoinnin profiilia: innostuneet (27 %), keskimääräinen opiskeluhyvinvointi (27 %), kyynistyneet (9 %), innostuneet mutta väsyneet (27 %) ja uupuneet (10 %).Uupuneet raportoivat eniten koettuja oppimisvaikeuksia ja innostuneet vähiten.Toisaalta uupuneiden profiilissa myös koettiin useimmiten erityisopettajalta saatu tuki riittäväksi ja innostuneiden profiilissa vähiten.Koettujen oppimisvaikeuksien näkökulma on jäänyt toistaiseksi vähäisemmälle huomiolle tutkimuskentällä, mutta niiden tarkastelu voisi esimerkiksi mahdollistaa opiskelijoiden todellisia tarpeita vastaavien tukemisen käytänteiden kehittämisen.Opiskeluhyvinvointia ei myöskään tulisi ohittaa koetuista oppimisvaikeuksista puhuttaessa, sillä tämä tutkielma antaa viitteitä niiden keskinäisistä yhteyksistä ja oppimisen tuki saattaisi myös tukea opiskeluhyvinvointia.

tittel: Mentorship And Wealth Creation: Analysing The Socio-Economic Impact Of The Igbo Apprenticeship System On Entrepreneurship In Nigeria
sammendrag: The Igbo apprenticeship system exemplifies a sustainable, grassroots approach to economic development and poverty alleviation. This model balances mentoring and practical business exposure and efforts at community-driven entrepreneurship. Therefore, this investigation elucidates the nexus between mentorship-and-wealth-creation, and the socio-cultural impacts of the Igbo apprenticeship system on entrepreneurship viability in Nigeria. In adopting a conceptual approach, the study therefore relied on literature data in its inference-making and conclusions. With the findings revealing that a major influence of the Igbo apprenticeship system is not only on entrepreneurship viability but it is also an enhanced form of mentorship and strategy for wealth creation. Thus concluding that that the Igbo apprenticeship system in Nigeria is a unique and effective model for economic empowerment, self-reliance, and poverty alleviation. While as a policy implication, this study offers that it will be beneficial to endear this system to become modernized through structured partnership with government and private sectors, providing legal frameworks, access to funding, and scalability while sustaining the core communal values.

tittel: Perspectives on Technical and Vocational Education and Training: Are young people prejudiced against it?
kilde: International Journal of Multidisciplinary Perspectives in Higher Education
sammendrag: In the contemporary workplaces, people must adapt to the dynamics of the market. The Covid-19 pandemic has highlighted this fact as people had to learn new skills, upgrade existing ones, or relocate to new jobs for sustenance. Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET), offering quick skilling, up-skilling, and re-skilling opportunities to people, fits in this scenario. However, TVET has a poor image compared to academic pathways, resulting in low TVET enrollment. A focused-group discussion with students and recent university graduates in Bhutan revealed that while TVET’s image problem exists, the image itself is a composite of other factors. In particular, the young people’s interest in TVET (or lack thereof) is defined by lack of advocacy in schools for TVET, supply-driven TVET with limited choices, and TVET careers accruing poor economic returns to individuals. Thus, effective social marketing and career advice services in schools, adopting a demand-driven approach to TVET development, and entrepreneurship tracks and collaborative efforts to incentivize vocational careers are some recommended interventions.

tittel: Factors Affecting School Dropout: Empirical Study In Nepal
forfattere: Mr. Jayaram Wagley, Prof. Dr. Amiya Bhaumik, Dr. Surendra Neupane
sammendrag: The main purpose of the study is to identify the factors that influence the student dropout in school especially in Kathmandu valley. Through questionnaires, the primary data were collected from 423 respondents including dropout students and their parents. The simple random sampling method was used for this study. Student and health-related factors (SH), School and teacher-related factors (ST), Family and economy-related factors (FF), Government related factors (GF) and Socio-cultural and parental attitude-related factors (SC) have been chosen as independent variables whereas school dropout as a dependent variable of the study. Likewise, parents’ education is taken as a moderating variable for this study. The collected data were analysed through SPSS. SEM (structural equation modelling) smart PLS-4 is used to know the relationship between the independent and dependent variable as well as effect of moderating variable. The results demonstrate that parents’ education plays a significant moderating role in the relationships between student and health-related factors and school and teacher-related factors with dropout decisions. However, parents’ education does not demonstrate a significant moderating effect on the relationships between family and economy-related factors, government-related factors, and socio-cultural and parental attitude-related factors with dropout decisions in this study.

tittel: CURRICULUM IMPLEMENTATI ON DUAL TRACK IN PROGRESS STUDENT COMPETENCIES AT SMA NEGERI 1 SANGATTA SELATAN
kilde: International Journal of Cultural and Social Science.
sammendrag: Improving the competency of students who do not continue their education after graduation is a crucial need to prepare them to enter the workforce or become entrepreneurs. School data shows that 34% of graduates of SMA Negeri 1 Sangatta Selatan do not continue their education. This study aims to describe the principal's management in planning, organizing, implementing, and supervising the dual-track curriculum. The study used a qualitative approach with a case study method. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation, then analyzed using the Miles and Huberman interactive model. The results showed that program planning was carried out collaboratively and based on student needs with a flexible schedule, organization through a clear team structure according to competencies, implementation through theoretical and practical learning using the 3P method in the fields of fashion design, culinary design, make-up, and multimedia, as well as continuous supervision and monitoring. The implementation of the dual-track curriculum has proven effective in improving student competency as a provision for work and entrepreneurship and has the potential to be developed in schools with similar characteristics.

tittel: Strategic Partnership Management In Vocational Training Institutions To Support Industry 5.0 Readiness: A Systematic Literature Review
forfattere: Lutfi Ariefianto, Ali Imron, Sri Wahyuni, Teguh Triwijanto
sammendrag: This study aims to explore and identify how partnership management can support Industry 5.0 readiness in vocational training institutions in Indonesia. The study employs a systematic literature review (SLR) and bibliometric analysis using the PRISMA Protocol as a guide. A dataset of articles from Scopus, PubMed, Crossref, and Google Scholar between 2014 and 2024 was analyzed using Vosviewer software to visualize bibliometric networks. The findings reveal the publication of 59 articles indicating that involving the government, private sector, educational institutions, and non-governmental organizations has been proven to accelerate the workforce transformation process into becoming more flexible and technology-oriented. This partnership aims to enhance the capacity and effectiveness of vocational training institutions in meeting industry market demands and preparing a more adaptive, innovative, and future-ready workforce to support Industry 5.0 readiness. The collaboration ensures that training curricula align with labor market needs, provides modern facilities and equipment, and improves instructor competence through training and certification. The government also plays a role in supporting this partnership through financial and regulatory backing, while continuous evaluation helps ensure that training programs remain relevant and effective.

tittel: Investigating Junior High School Student in Learning Reading Through Word Search Puzzle Game : Case Study
sammendrag: Many students struggle to form simple sentences for everyday conversations. Vocabulary is the main foundation of language, and the richness of a person's understanding greatly determines their ability to capture meaning, understand context, and connect ideas in a text. Teachers must pay special attention to gain students' motivation to expand their vocabulary. Therefore, the research aimed to explore the implementation and investigate students in word-search puzzle games as a learning medium to assist students in reading classrooms. The researcher used qualitative research with a case study design. Five students of junior high school students were involved in this research. Research data was collected through interviews and observation. The data was analyzed by thematic analysis. The study found that teachers implementing a learning strategy following the theory of Safadi and Rababah encourage student engagement and improve reading skills by using the Word Search Puzzle Game as a learning medium. There are four stages to implementing this strategy. This strategy can encourage students to learn so that they can explore their reading skills. It can be concluded that integrating the Word Search Puzzle Game into reading learning can increase students' cognitive, affective, and behavioral engagement and prove that interactive and exciting learning media can help achieve learning.

tittel: Effectiveness of Behavior Contract–Based Group Counseling in Reducing Truancy among Junior High School Students
sammendrag: This study aimed to examine the effectiveness of behavior contract–based group counseling in reducing truancy behavior among junior high school students. A quantitative approach with a pre-experimental one-group pretest–posttest design was employed. The participants consisted of 11 seventh-grade students identified through a needs assessment as having high levels of truancy. Data were collected using a validated truancy behavior questionnaire. Data analysis was conducted using the Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test. The results showed a decrease in the mean truancy score from 66.73 in the pretest to 54.18 in the posttest, with a Z value of −3.059 and a significance level of 0.001 (p < 0.05). These findings indicate that group counseling integrated with behavior contract techniques is effective in reducing truancy behavior. The novelty of this study lies in applying a structured behavioral contract within group counseling in an Islamic junior high school context.

tittel: Study Engagement and Perceived Lifelong Employability: Survey of TVET Students across South-South Nigeria
sammendrag: This study examined the influence of study engagement on technical and vocational education and training (TVET) students’ perception of lifelong employability. A quantitative research design was adopted to examine the levels of study engagement dimensions (vigor, dedication, and absorption) and their influence on TVET students’ perception of lifelong employability. The sample consists of 285 final-year TVET students in public universities in South-South Nigeria. The instruments for data collection were two structured questionnaires adapted from existing measurement scales. The instruments for data collection were validated by three experts, each in technical education, business education, and measurement and evaluation. Cronbach’s alpha was used in calculating the internal consistency of the items on the two measurement scales, yielding reliability coefficients: vigor = .833, dedication = .888, absorption = .807, overall study engagement = .934, and perceived lifelong employability = .700. The authors used the descriptive statistics (mean and standard deviation) and inferential statistics (correlation and regression) for data analysis. The result showed that TVET students experienced low study engagement, such that their level of study vigor, study dedication, study absorption and overall study engagement towards the performance of their study activities were generally low. The result showed that study vigor, study dedication, study absorption, overall study engagement and perceived lifelong employability were positively correlated. The result also showed that study vigor, study dedication, study absorption, overall study engagement and perceived lifelong employability were significantly related. The authors concluded that the low overall study engagement experienced by students accounted for the negative influence on their perception of lifelong employability. The authors therefore recommended, among others, that TVET leaders and managers should devise strategic mechanisms that would foster high study engagement so as to positively influence TVET students’ perception of lifelong employability

tittel: School engagement among pregnant and mothering adolescents in sub-Saharan Africa: A multisystemic resilience-informed scoping review
sammendrag: Adolescent pregnancy and motherhood are highly prevalent in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where early parenthood is closely linked to school dropout and constrained opportunities. Using a multisystemic resilience framework, this scoping review synthesises evidence on the barriers and facilitators at individual, relational, structural and cultural levels that shape the schooling engagement of pregnant and mothering adolescents in SSA. We systematically searched EBSCOhost, Scopus, and Web of Science, supplemented by reference list reviews and expert consultations. Thirty-one studies met the inclusion criteria, spanning nine SSA countries. Data were analysed thematically, drawing on the concept of multisystemic resilience. Findings highlight a complex interplay between adolescent mothers’ agency and the resources available within their environments. Key barriers to schooling include stigma and discrimination, financial hardship, childcare responsibilities, and inconsistent implementation of re-entry policies. Facilitators for schooling engagement include adolescent mothers’ motivation and aspirations, supportive relationships with family members, partners, peers, and teachers, and access to structural supports such as fee waivers, childcare, and flexible schooling options. Positive community norms and role models further reinforced school engagement. By integrating evidence across multiple SSA contexts through a multisystemic resilience lens, this review offers a novel, multi-level synthesis of how barriers and facilitators intersect to shape schooling pathways for adolescent mothers. While most existing research is qualitative from South Africa and Kenya, findings indicate the importance of contextually grounded interventions that combine psychosocial and structural supports. Strengthening re-entry policy implementation, reducing stigma, and expanding evidence on effective interventions are critical to improving educational outcomes for adolescent mothers in SSA.
